_about: Build extras for Day 14 (read by tools/build_day.py). Several Calculation Drill problems ask for two quantities; calc_parts gives one answer box per quantity (values from the document's worked answers, arithmetic re-checked). calc_questions reword two-part prompts so each asked quantity is explicit. The Distractor Rewrite Working Edition overwrote the correct option of Q12, Q21, Q23, Q34, Q40 and Q50 (the keyed letter now holds a distractor); keep_questions takes those six whole from the previous edition. Its placeholder why-not lines ("Distractor revised …") are dropped.
title: Nutrition & Micronutrients

calc_questions.title: F-75 volumes in complicated SAM
calc_questions.question: A 7.5-kg child with complicated SAM (no gross oedema) needs F-75 at 130 mL/kg/day given as 12 feeds. What is the daily volume, and what volume is given per feed?

calc_questions.title: F-75 volume and energy with gross oedema
calc_questions.question: An 8-kg child with gross oedema starts F-75 at 100 mL/kg/day. F-75 contains 75 kcal/100 mL. What is the total daily volume, and how many kcal/day does it provide?

calc_questions.title: MAM energy target
calc_questions.question: A 9-kg child with MAM targets a total intake of 130 kcal/kg/day. How many kcal/day is that?

calc_questions.title: F-100 volume in rehabilitation
calc_questions.question: A 10-kg child in rehabilitation targets 160 kcal/kg/day and receives F-100 (100 kcal/100 mL) as the only illustrative feed. What volume per day is needed?

calc_questions.title: Iron syrup volume
calc_questions.question: A 14-kg child is prescribed elemental iron 3 mg/kg/day. The syrup contains 20 mg elemental iron per mL. What volume of syrup is given per day?

calc_questions.title: Dextrose bolus in SAM hypoglycaemia
calc_questions.question: A 6.5-kg child with symptomatic hypoglycaemia in SAM needs 10% dextrose 5 mL/kg IV (IAP 2026). What volume is given, and how many grams of glucose does it contain?

calc_questions.title: GIR
calc_questions.question: A 1.5-kg preterm infant receives D10 at 120 mL/kg/day. What is the glucose infusion rate (GIR)?

calc_questions.title: Catch-up energy and F-100 equivalent
calc_questions.question: A 12-kg 2-year-old is set a monitored catch-up target of 150 kcal/kg/day. What is the total energy per day, and what F-100 volume (about 1 kcal/mL) would supply it, for arithmetic only?
